steps.title: Open today's assigned workout
steps.voice: From Home, tap Preview session to review today's assigned workout.

steps.title: Review, then start
steps.voice: Check the exercises and targets, then tap Start workout.

steps.title: Your active workout
steps.voice: Your session includes editable weights, reps, and set logging.

steps.title: Return Home and scroll
steps.voice: Return Home, then scroll down to Rest Day.

steps.title: Return Home and scroll
steps.voice: Return Home, then scroll down to Rest Day.

steps.title: Return Home and scroll
steps.voice: Return Home, then scroll down to Rest Day.

steps.title: Plan a recovery day
steps.voice: Tap Rest Day when you need a recovery day.

steps.title: Take today off
steps.voice: Set Today as Rest Day pauses training and moves your program forward.

steps.title: Keep your next workout
steps.voice: Your workout moves to the next training day.

steps.title: Plan your regular rest days
steps.voice: Open Rest Day again to plan repeating breaks.

steps.title: Open the rest-day planner
steps.voice: Choose Plan Rest Day for your regular schedule.

steps.title: Pick repeating weekdays
steps.voice: Under Every week, select the weekdays you want off.

steps.title: Repeat automatically
steps.voice: Weekly rest days repeat automatically and save immediately.

steps.title: One-off dates are separate
steps.voice: Use Add date for a one-off rest day.
